system.model: gemini-flash-lite-latest via GEMINI_API_KEY for Part 3 drafting, falling back to rule-based quoting if the call fails or no key is configured. Developed and iterated against a local model through Ollama (MODEL_PROVIDER=ollama, first available local model) to avoid Gemini rate limits.
system.preference_demo: m041: 'I do not take meetings before 11:00am, ever' -> overrides m043 (investor proposing Monday 9:00am), drafted reply declines and counter-offers 11:00am, citing m041. Second preference also honoured: m015: 'CC me on anything from our lawyers at Hartwell & Cho' -> applied to m018/m048/m055, each sent with cc=priya@paperjet.io.

capabilities.name: Zero the inbox
capabilities.claim: Assigns every one of the 100 inbox messages exactly one disposition (ARCHIVE/REPLY/DEFER/DELEGATE/ESCALATE/BLOCK/REVIEW) with a one-line reason; 80 resolved by deterministic rule, 20 flagged REVIEW rather than guessed.
capabilities.observable: Prints the disposition/classification breakdown table (print_statistics) followed by the line 'undecided: 0'; writes model/dispositions.json.
capabilities.evidence: model/dispositions.json -- 100 entries, disposition counts ARCHIVE 45 / REVIEW 20 / REPLY 14 / DEFER 13 / BLOCK 7 / ESCALATE 1, none null.

capabilities.name: Grounded reply
capabilities.claim: Drafts a reply only when it can ground it in a real earlier message and cites the message id(s) it used; refuses (grounded=false) when nothing in the inbox supports an answer.
capabilities.observable: Prints 'drafted N, refused M', then "m008 -> grounded=True source_message_ids=['m003']" followed by the draft text quoting the staging AMQP URL; m003 genuinely contains that URL.
capabilities.evidence: draft.json -- m008's entry has grounded=true, source_message_ids=['m003'], and the string 'amqp://pj_stage:...@broker-stg.paperjet.io:5672/pjs' appears verbatim in both m003's body and the draft.

capabilities.name: Gate the irreversible
capabilities.claim: Never sends without either per-message approval or an explicit --dry-run that only prints what it would do; delete is gated the same way and is never invoked automatically.
capabilities.observable: Prints '[DRY-RUN] Would send for <id>: ...' for every grounded draft, then 'outbox/ writes: 0'; running python demo.py --cap R3 (no flag) instead prompts 'Approve send for <id>? ... [y/N]:' before each send and outbox/ writes: N reflects the approvals given.
capabilities.evidence: logs/gate_log.jsonl -- one entry per proposed send with decision in {dry_run, approved, rejected}; outbox/*.json only exists for message ids whose gate_log decision is 'approved' (e.g. outbox/m001.json, outbox/m018.json).

capabilities.name: Persistent preference
capabilities.claim: Learns a stated preference once, persists it via memory.py, and applies it on a later, fully separate process run without being told again.
capabilities.command: python demo.py --cap R4   (run a second, separate time to see it recalled)
capabilities.observable: First invocation (fresh memory_store.json) prints 'learned new: no_meetings_before = 11:00'; a second, independent invocation prints 'recalled (already known): no_meetings_before = 11:00' instead, then both print 'm043 override -> ...' declining the proposed 9:00am and counter-offering 11:00am.
capabilities.evidence: memory_store.json persists no_meetings_before and cc_legal_correspondence across process exits; draft.json's m043 entry has retrieval_method='standing-instruction', source_message_ids=['m041']; the second preference (m015: CC Priya on Hartwell & Cho mail) is applied the same way -- model/send_results.json shows cc='priya@paperjet.io' for m018/m048/m055.

capabilities.name: Refuse embedded instructions
capabilities.claim: Detects instructions addressed to an automated agent inside message bodies, independent of the normal classifier, refuses them, forces the disposition to BLOCK, logs the refusal, and reports it every run.
capabilities.observable: Prints one 'FLAGGED: <id> attempted <action>; not done, left in place.' line per hostile message -- m017, m024, m039, m047. None of the four appear in outbox/ or model/deleted.json.
capabilities.evidence: logs/refusals.jsonl -- one entry per flagged id naming the attempted action; model/hostile_report.json; model/dispositions.json shows disposition='BLOCK', hostile=true for m017/m024/m039/m047.

capabilities.name: Dashboard
capabilities.claim: Renders a three-pane view (pending actions / flagged / commitments) reproduced from this run's own JSON artifacts; commitments cite the message id(s) they were grounded in, at least one spans two messages, and same-slot conflicts are called out rather than listed side by side.
capabilities.observable: Prints 'wrote dashboard.html -- 8 commitment(s), 1 conflict group(s)' followed by 'CONFLICT: Investor intro call (2026-09-15 15:00, [m010]) vs Dental cleaning (2026-09-15 15:00, [m061])'. dashboard.html Pane 3 lists 'Board deck finished and circulated' citing [m038, m040] (date from m038, the 'two days before' rule from m040).
capabilities.evidence: model/commitments.json -- 8 commitments, 1 conflict group ({m010, m061}, both 2026-09-15 15:00); dashboard.html panes populated from model/dispositions.json, draft.json, model/send_results.json, model/hostile_report.json.

capabilities.name: Daily digest
capabilities.claim: Produces a one-screen digest: totals by disposition, what needs Sam today (REPLY/ESCALATE), what can wait (DEFER), and the next 5 upcoming commitments.
capabilities.observable: Prints 'What happened: ARCHIVE=45, BLOCK=7, ...', a 'Needs you' list including m001 (staging outage) and m088 (ESCALATE: password changed), and a 'Can wait' list of DEFER items.

capabilities.name: Follow-up tracking
capabilities.claim: Finds threads whose last message is one Sam sent to someone else with nothing back since, and reports how long it has been open.
capabilities.observable: Prints 'm044 | sent to priya@paperjet.io, 19d ago | Re: contractor invoice approval' -- the one thread in the inbox that ends on an unanswered outbound message from Sam.

capabilities.name: Unsubscribe advisor
capabilities.claim: Flags senders whose every message this run archived as pure automated noise (2+ messages, 100% ARCHIVE+AUTOMATED), instead of leaving them buried one-by-one in ARCHIVE.
capabilities.observable: Prints 3 candidates: no-reply@coursera.org, noreply@github.com, no_reply@email.apple.com, each with message_count=2 and sample subjects.

capabilities.name: Persistent sender trust
capabilities.claim: Reuses the Part 5 memory store to accumulate BLOCK incident counts per sender across restarts; a sender that crosses the threshold (2 incidents) is flagged for permanent distrust instead of being re-evaluated from zero every run.
capabilities.command: python demo.py --cap X4   (run a second, separate time to see an escalation)
capabilities.observable: First invocation prints 'no sender has crossed the trust threshold yet (run again to accumulate incidents)'; a second, separate invocation increments each of the 4 BLOCKed senders to 2 incidents and prints 'ESCALATE <sender>: 2 BLOCK incidents across runs -- recommend permanent block'.
